integrity: The exact covariance is derived from category-occurrence and pair-match indicators. Its strict sign follows from a weighted rearrangement inequality, independently of numerical experiments. The birthday-scale limit uses an explicit triple-collision L2 bound. A standalone exact-rational checker exhaustively replays nonuniform finite examples and a high-precision asymptotic diagnostic.
scientific_limitations: The exact strict-sign theorem is stated for finite categorical laws; countably infinite support is not claimed.
The perfect-anticorrelation limit is proved only for the uniform birthday scaling with n/sqrt(m) tending to a finite positive constant.
Negative covariance does not imply full negative association.
title: Distinct-value counts are universally anticorrelated with pair collisions
